description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) develops AI and telematics technology for safer mobility. The Software Engineer I, Cloud contributes to full-stack development of scalable, performant cloud applications, translating complex problems into business solutions and collaborating on code and design reviews.
Software Engineer, Cloud designing and developing maintainable full-stack applications and translating business requirements into technical solutions

Responsibilities:
• Use independent judgment and discretion to make contributions to the team using proper software development procedures and method
• Assist in solving complex problems and transform them into business solutions
• Participate in code and design reviews
• Full stack design and development with a focus on maintainability, usability, scalability and performance
• Help analyze and translate business and functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications
• Provide required support for occasional production issues
• Follow the company’s development and operational standards and processes
• Complete any additional tasks as they arise

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in Computer Science or related field
• Ability to learn quickly and solve complex problems
• Ability to collaborate in a team environment
• Ability to do general development tasks on Linux
• Python, Swift or Kotlin
• AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, SNS, SQS
• Creating, maintaining: CI/CD pipelines
• Containerization technologies (specifically Docker)
• Developing web applications (HTTP REST backend, React frontend)

Preferred:
• Some professional engineering experience preferred
